mapper.select: SELECT i.item_id , item_name , item_brand , item_price , item_category , item_url FROM item i JOIN item_img ii ON i.item_id = ii.item_id WHERE item_category = #{itemCategory}
SELECT i.item_id , item_name , item_brand , item_price , item_category , item_url FROM item i JOIN item_img ii ON i.item_id = ii.item_id WHERE item_category = 14 AND item_brand = #{brand}

SELECT i.item_id as itemId, i.item_name as itemName, i.item_brand as itemBrand, i.item_price as itemPrice, i.item_category as itemCategory, img.item_url as itemUrl FROM item i LEFT JOIN item_img img ON i.item_id = img.item_id WHERE (img.is_main = '1' OR img.is_main IS NULL) AND (i.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR i.item_brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY i.reg_time DESC
